body:
## Objective
Close the expert lifecycle last: expert-delta mapping, D-141 qualification (falsification surface), kaizen robustness/validation feed, assurance/EEO/governance remainder — measured against the closed scoring of the earlier chain issues.

## Owning authority
- `v8-core/src/experts/` (34 files) vs `v8-next/src/v8_next/experts/` (26 files) — delta to map
- `v8-core/src/qualification/mod.rs` (D-141 Expert Proving Ground & Alpha Refinery; falsification surface, never economic authority)
- `v8-core/src/kaizen/` (robustness.rs, validation.rs first; controller/loop last)
- `v8-core/src/assurance/` (adjudicate, defeater, evidence_profile, attestation remainder)
- `v8-core/src/eeo/` (mapping-first: headers unread at filing; mapping is R1)
- `v8-core/src/judiciary/`, `tevv/`, `scheduler/rename_audit.rs`, `v8-core/src/bin/epistemic_succession.rs` (governance remainder, lowest priority)
- Explicitly NOT this issue: `backend/` (polars/numpy own it), `usdm_sim/` simulator (Nautilus owns it), O4 regret (absent by design)

## Change class
CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION

## Current state
- 26 expert modules ported with vectorized indicators (`test_vectorized_indicators_perf.py`); trial/compare/forward/family/store cover the experiment loop; certificate/claims cover part of assurance.
- Missing: expert file delta (34→26), qualification falsification surface, kaizen P3-feed, assurance/EEO/governance remainder.

## Required end state
- R1 — EEO + expert-delta mapping published (file-by-file: ported / delta / wont-port-with-reason) before any code in this issue.
- R2 — Expert delta ported (logic handmade, vectorization via polars; no per-expert perf regression vs existing vectorized baselines).
- R3 — Qualification falsification surface: semantic evidence separated from real-tape attribution; produces no economic verdict (by construction + test).
- R4 — Kaizen robustness/validation feed P3 scenarios; controller/loop parts ported last with explicit no-autonomy guard (no live activation path).
- R5 — Assurance/EEO/governance remainder ported in that priority order; judiciary/tev vetting recorded as accountability-plane only (no product behavior change).
- R6 — Gates green (incl. perf tests where touched).

## Expected file / module surface
- `v8-next/src/v8_next/experts/` (delta modules)
- NEW `v8-next/src/v8_next/qualification/` (falsification surface)
- `v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/` (kaizen feed wiring), assurance remainder modules
- Mapping doc: `docs/` location TBD in R1 (do not scatter; single mapping artifact)
- `v8-next/tests/test_expert_delta.py`, `test_qualification_*.py`

## Verification gates
```sh
uv run --project v8-next --extra dev ruff check v8-next/src v8-next/tests
uv run --project v8-next --extra dev mypy v8-next/src/v8_next/experts v8-next/src/v8_next/qualification
uv run --project v8-next --extra dev pytest -q v8-next/tests/test_vectorized_indicators_perf.py v8-next/tests/test_family.py
```

## Required evidence artifacts
- R1 mapping artifact (path + sha256).
- Qualification falsification report sample (NO verdict present — assert absence).
- Gate logs. PENDING until produced.

## Non-goals / forbidden scope
- No economic verdict from qualification (structural prohibition, tested).
- No autonomous kaizen loop activation (research loop stays human-dispatched; cf. dispatcher contract).
- No backend/simd work; no usdm_sim simulator; no O4.
- No economic claim.

## 11. Normative Traceability
- R1 — Mapping before code. Authority: boundary-change discipline (skill `v8-lab-dev` §1); WORK_ITEM_POLICY.
- R2 — Expert parity + perf. Authority: `v8-core/src/experts/*`; existing perf tests.
- R3 — Falsification-not-authority. Authority: `v8-core/src/qualification/mod.rs` (D-141).
- R4 — Kaizen feed. Authority: `v8-core/src/kaizen/{robustness,validation}.rs`; P3 scenarios (`evaluation/scenarios.py`).
- R5 — Assurance/EEO/governance. Authority: `v8-core/src/assurance/mod.rs` (D-147/149/150); `src/eeo/mod.rs` (D-136); judiciary mod (D-134, Rules 36–42).
- R6 — Gates. Authority: `v8-next/AGENTS.md`.

## 12. Existing Types / Interfaces to Reuse
- Ported expert modules + `catalog.py`/`registry.py` (extend, don't fork expert ontology).
- Trial/compare/forward/family/store experiment loop (kaizen feeds it, doesn't replace it).
- Ported `certificate.py`/`claims.py` (assurance remainder extends).
- polars vectorized indicator patterns (existing perf tests are the contract).

## 13. Mathematical / Semantic Invariants
- I1 — Qualification output contains no economic verdict type. Testable: type/field absence test on the falsification report.
- I2 — Expert delta preserves trigger semantics bit-for-bit on golden fixtures (parity with Rust where fixtures exist). Testable: fixture equality.
- I3 — Kaizen feed cannot open orders or live paths (no execution import in feed modules). Testable: import-surface test.

## 14. Canonical Failure Semantics
- Unmapped expert semantic (no Rust counterpart, no receipt) -> OPEN_PIN, not invention.
- Qualification asked for a verdict -> refusal.
- Kaizen feed touching live/private surface -> hard failure.

## 15. Dependency Map
Chain issue #6 (closed scoring) -> R1 mapping -> expert delta + qualification -> kaizen feed -> assurance/EEO/governance remainder. No downstream chain issues (terminal).

## 16. Ambiguity / OPEN_PIN Triggers
- If EEO headers reveal product behavior (not just observability), STOP and re-scope before coding (this issue assumes observability/governance remainder).
- If D-141 qualification contradicts NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM anywhere, STOP and escalate (constitution wins).
- Default catch-all applies.

## References
- `docs/issues/ISSUE_KZ001_EXPERT_FORENSICS_AND_FAILURE_TAXONOMY.md` and KZ-series (context).

## V8 guards
- [x] I will not invent a new canonical error code, ontology, or parallel interface unless an R# requirement explicitly authorizes it.
- [x] No unrelated semantic strategy change is bundled into this implementation issue.
- [x] No frozen OOS is opened unless this issue explicitly carries that authority.
- [x] If the owning contract is ambiguous, I will open/escalate an OPEN_PIN rather than invent an interpretation.
